disclosureQuote: The four assets in this work—one UI component and three landscape paintings used as wall decorations (frames not included)—were produced using additional AI for refinement. None of them were created by AI from the ground up. AI helped with grammatical corrections for in-game text, which were then carefully reviewed and adjusted by hand. We only consider AI to be a supportive tool. Every detail is meticulously crafted with human intent, as our creative process is still firmly anchored in manual craftsmanship.
summary: 图书馆整理模拟游戏。开发者披露四个素材（一个 UI 组件与三张墙面风景画）经生成式 AI 进一步润色，并明确没有一个由 AI 从零生成；游戏内文本的语法修正由 AI 辅助后再人工复核。
reviewNote: 核查 Steam 完整披露、身份与英文界面讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 290）。另读 2 个主题正文及可见回复：一帖征集不使用生成式 AI 的同类游戏，另一帖有玩家询问开发者是否会停止使用 AI，两帖均未见开发者回应。逐款检索公开报道 2 次、登记 12 条结果，读到 Aftermath 长评原文并计入来源，检索非穷尽。结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。
description: 单人图书馆整理模拟；官方把 AI 用途限定在四个素材的润色与文本语法辅助，并声明均由人工复核。

english.summary: A single-player library tidying sim. The developer discloses that four assets (one UI component and three wall paintings) were further refined with generative AI while none were created from the ground up, and that AI assisted grammatical fixes to in-game text before hand review.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full Steam disclosure, identity and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 290). Also read 2 topic threads and their visible replies: one asks for similar games without generative AI and another asks whether the studio will stop using it, with no developer answer visible in either. Public coverage was searched per game and the Aftermath impressions article was read in full; search is not exhaustive. Findings rely on developer statements, not an independent audit.
